title: ericoides mammosum
intro: Ericoides mammosum, commonly known as the "Uva Ursi" or "Bearberry", is a flowering plant native to Europe and North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include treating urinary tract infections due to its antiseptic and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of Uva Ursi include reducing inflammation, acting as an antimicrobial agent, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Ericoides mammosum include arbutin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
